# AEROVA

> Premium atmospheric water generators (AWG) for Vietnam. Creates mineralized, alkaline drinking water directly from air humidity — no water pipes, no plastic bottles.

AEROVA Technologies manufactures the LT-AWG20G atmospheric water generator, which condenses moisture from the air through a 7-stage filtration system to produce up to 20 litres per day of mineralised alkaline drinking water (pH 7.4+). Designed specifically for Vietnam's humid tropical climate (70–85% average humidity). No pipe connection required. Free installation in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi.

## Product

- [AEROVA LT-AWG20G — Atmospheric Water Generator](https://aerova.asia/product): Full product specifications. 20L/day output, 7-stage filtration (HEPA → condensation → sediment → activated carbon → reverse osmosis → UV-C → mineralisation), 45dB operating noise, mildly alkaline pH 7.4+, 2-year warranty, 30-day money-back guarantee.

## Key Facts

- Technology: Atmospheric Water Generation (AWG) — extracts drinking water from ambient air humidity
- Output: up to 20 litres per day at 80% relative humidity, 25°C
- Filtration stages: 7 (HEPA air filter, condensation coils, PP sediment, GAC activated carbon, RO membrane, UV-C sterilisation, calcium-magnesium mineralisation)
- Water quality: pH 7.4–8.5 (mildly alkaline), TDS <50ppm after RO stage
- Operating noise: 45dB
- No plumbing required: runs from a standard 220V power outlet
- Target market: Vietnam residential (apartments, villas), hospitality, and commercial
- Purchase price: approx. USD 1,500 (VAT included)
- Running cost: approx. USD 0.03 per litre vs USD 0.30–0.60 for bottled water
- Free installation: Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi
